4:1.sourceText: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετ’ ἐμοῦ, λέγων Ἀνάβα ὧδε, καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.
4:1.targetText: After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in the sky, and the first voice that I heard—as of a trumpet speaking with me, saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must come to pass after these things”;

groups.note: Actual tauta is accusative-neuter-plural demonstrative, expanded these-things through its substantive use; no separately printed thing noun occurs.
Actual idou has both recorded V-2AMM-2S imperative analyses, retained under the conventional behold expression rather than silently retagged as an interjection.
Actual thyra is anarthrous nominative singular door noun, expanded a-door without a separately written indefinite article.
Actual ēneōgmenē is PERFECT PASSIVE nominative-feminine-singular opening participle, rendered opened while retaining actual perfect/participial form, not an active or finite retag.
Actual salpingos is anarthrous genitive-feminine-singular trumpet noun in the comparison frame, expanded of-a-trumpet with its actual case and no independently printed of/indefinite article.

Actual lalousēs is present active GENITIVE FEMININE singular speaking participle following the trumpet comparison. Its real form remains without asserting agreement with nominative voice or settling the comparison attachment.

Actual legōn is present active NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular saying participle. Complete printed TR has feminine legousa; the actual masculine source form remains under saying without identifying an additional speaker or silently changing its gender.
Actual anaba is second-aorist active second-singular ascending imperative, expanded Come-up without a separate printed up adverb.
Actual dei is present active third-singular impersonal necessity predicate, rendered must without an invented modal source lemma.
Actual genesthai is second-aorist nonactive/deponent becoming infinitive, rendered come-to-pass as one lexical predicate, not separate come/pass source words.
This actual tauta is a separate accusative-neuter-plural demonstrative occurrence and owns only the final these-things.

unmappedSource.reason: The repeated attributive article before first is not separately expressed in the single English the-first-voice construction.

4:2.sourceText: εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν Πνεύματι· καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος,
4:2.targetText: and immediately I was in [the] Spirit, and behold, a throne was set in Heaven, and on the throne is [One] sitting,

groups.note: Actual egenomēn is second-aorist nonactive/deponent first-singular becoming predicate, rendered I-was with actual ginomai identity and aorist retained, not an eimi source substituted.
Actual pneumati is anarthrous dative-neuter-singular Spirit noun, expanded bracketed-the Spirit without an independently printed source article.

Actual ekeito is imperfect nonactive third-singular lying/being-set predicate of keimai, rendered was-set; its real state verb and imperfect/nonactive form remain, not a tithēmi setting passive source.

Actual kathēmenos is anarthrous present nonactive nominative-masculine-singular sitting participle used personally, expanded [One]-sitting. One supplies the nominal person realization, not a separately written Greek one numeral or pronoun; the distinct English is stays unpaired.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with Heaven is not separately expressed in the English bare place designation.

unmappedTarget.reason: Displayed LSV adds opening and, corroborated by the initial kai in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 begins with immediately and has no independently printed opening conjunction here.
English supplies this copula in the nominal/anarthrous sitting-participle clause. No independent Greek eimi/being finite is written there.

4:3.sourceText: καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ, καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ.
4:3.targetText: and He who is sitting was in appearance like a stone, jasper and sardine: and a rainbow was around the throne in appearance like an emerald.

groups.note: Actual nominative-masculine-singular article nominalizes the written sitting participle and owns He-who as its personal frame; no independent Greek he or relative pronoun is invented.

Actual kathēmenos is present nonactive nominative-masculine-singular sitting participle, rendered finite English is-sitting with its real participial form retained, distinct from the supplied comparison was.
Actual horasei is dative-feminine-singular appearance noun, expanded in-appearance as a nominal case relation without an independently printed en.

Actual sardiō is recorded dative-neuter-singular sardion stone NOUN in both fields; English sardine retains that stone head. Complete printed TR has sardinō, an adjectival form, which is not substituted or used to retag this noun.
Actual iris is anarthrous nominative-feminine-singular rainbow noun, expanded a-rainbow; no further identification of the pictured object is supplied.

Actual second homoios is recorded NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular adjective in both source fields, although iris is feminine. That actual form is retained under like without a silent gender correction or settled syntactic attachment.
This actual horasei is the second dative-feminine-singular appearance noun and owns the second in-appearance, independently of the earlier occurrence.

Actual smaragdinō is dative-masculine-singular emerald-related ADJECTIVE, rendered nominal English an-emerald with its real smaragdinos head and A-DSM analyses retained; no source emerald noun or article is invented.

unmappedTarget.reason: The first English was follows the actual ēn finite printed in complete TR after the sitting phrase. Actual N1904 has no being finite at this nominal comparison.
The second English was supplies a copula in the rainbow/comparison clause. No independently written Greek being finite is present there in actual N1904 or complete printed TR.

4:4.sourceText: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς.
4:4.targetText: And around the throne [are] twenty-four thrones, and sitting on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders, having been clothed in white garments, and on their heads golden garlands;

groups.note: Actual first thronous is ACCUSATIVE masculine plural, whereas complete printed TR has nominative thronoi. The true source case remains under the first thrones without a subject-case retag.
Actual eikosi is an indeclinable twenty numeral, the first occurrence of two. The separate actual tessaras owns the hyphenated four portion; no and connective is invented between the N numerals.
This actual eikosi is the second indeclinable twenty occurrence, distinguished from the earlier throne count.
Actual presbyterous is accusative-masculine-plural COMPARATIVE adjective used personally, rendered elders with both recorded A-APM-C analyses retained, not retagged as an independently written noun.
Actual kathēmenous is PRESENT nonactive accusative-masculine-plural sitting participle, retained under sitting despite English reordering.
Actual peribeblēmenous is PERFECT PASSIVE accusative-masculine-plural clothing participle, expanded having-been-clothed; no separate source having/being predicates are printed.
Actual chrysous is accusative-masculine-plural golden/material adjective; the English adjective does not imply a separately written gold noun.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual heads article is not separately expressed beside the English possessive their-heads construction.

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies a copula in the first nominal throne/count clause; actual N1904 and complete printed TR have no independently written being finite there.
This English perception predicate follows actual eidon in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 has no independently printed seeing predicate at this point; the prior verse1 occurrence is not borrowed.

4:5.sourceText: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί· καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, ἅ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ·
4:5.targetText: and out of the throne proceed lightnings, and thunders, and voices; and seven lamps of fire are burning before the throne, which are the Seven Spirits of God,

groups.note: Actual ekporeuontai is present nonactive/deponent third-plural proceeding predicate, retained under proceed with its actual compound lexical identity.

Actual kai before voices owns the later English and-voices conjunction because N1904 voices precedes thunders while LSV follows the opposite printed TR order. The two source conjunctions remain distinct.
This actual kai before thunders owns the earlier English and-thunders conjunction; its real source occurrence is not swapped with the separate voices source identity.
Actual pyros is anarthrous genitive-neuter-singular fire noun, expanded of-fire through its case without a separate of source word.

Actual kaiomenai is PRESENT nonactive nominative-feminine-plural burning participle with functional V-PPP-NPF and formal V-PEP-NPF analyses, expanded English are-burning. Both real analyses remain rather than an English-inferred active tag or separate copula.
Actual ha is NOMINATIVE NEUTER PLURAL relative, rendered which with both source analyses retained. Complete printed TR has feminine hai; actual N gender is not silently altered.
Actual eisin is the separate present active third-plural being finite and owns the later English are, not the earlier participial burning auxiliary.
Actual genitive article/God noun jointly owns of-God as a case-governed nominal construction; no bare article assigned only of.

4:6.sourceText: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ· καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσερα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν.
4:6.targetText: and before the throne—a sea of glass like to crystal, and in the midst of the throne, and around the throne—four living creatures, full of eyes before and behind;

groups.note: Actual hyalinē is nominative-feminine-singular glassy/of-glass adjective, expanded of-glass while retaining its real adjective head rather than an independently written glass noun or of preposition.
Actual krystallō is dative-masculine-singular crystal noun in the homoios comparison, expanded to-crystal through its actual case/complement relation without a separately printed to preposition.
Actual mesō is dative-neuter-singular middle adjective used substantivally after en, expanded the-midst with its A-DSN tags retained, not a retagged noun or separately written article.

Actual kyklō is recorded N-DSM in both raw fields, used in the surrounding/circle relation and rendered around. Its real nominal analysis and source spelling remain, not a source peri preposition or adverb retag.
Actual zōa is one nominative-neuter-plural living-creature noun, expanded living-creatures without an independently written Greek living adjective.
Actual gemonta is PRESENT ACTIVE nominative-neuter-plural fullness participle, rendered full while retaining its real gemō verbal head and participial analysis, not a source plērēs adjective.
Actual ophthalmōn is genitive-masculine-plural eyes noun complementing the fullness participle, expanded of-eyes through its case.

unmappedSource.reason: Actual hōs comparison marker before sea has no independently expressed counterpart in LSV; complete printed TR omits this marker. The distinct actual homoia owns the later like comparison.

4:7.sourceText: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι, καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ἔχων τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς ἀνθρώπου, καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ.
4:7.targetText: and the first living creature—like a lion; and the second living creature—like a calf; and the third living creature has the face as a man; and the fourth living creature—like an eagle flying.

groups.note: The first actual zōon is a single living-creature noun; the other three written source occurrences each own their corresponding later English living-creature phrase.

Actual echōn is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular having participle V-PAP-NSM in both fields, rendered English finite has. Complete printed TR has neuter echon; actual masculine/participial form remains, not normalized to the gender of zōon or retagged finite.
Actual anthrōpou is GENITIVE masculine singular man noun in the comparison, rendered a-man while retaining actual case. Complete printed TR has nominative anthrōpos, which is not substituted.
Actual petomenō is present nonactive/deponent DATIVE MASCULINE singular flying participle modifying the dative eagle noun, retained under flying without a nominative retag.

unmappedSource.reason: The repeated attributive article before first is not separately expressed in the one English the-first-living-creature phrase.

4:8.sourceText: καὶ τὰ τέσσερα ζῷα, ἓν καθ’ ἓν αὐτῶν ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ, κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν· καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες Ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ, ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος.
4:8.targetText: And the four living creatures, one by one of them had six wings respectively, around and within [are] full of eyes, and they have no rest day and night, saying, “HOLY, HOLY, HOLY, the LORD God, the Almighty, who was, and who is, and who is coming”;

groups.note: Actual first hen is NOMINATIVE neuter singular one numeral; the separately written second hen is ACCUSATIVE under kata. Together the separately anchored words form one-by-one without merging their actual cases or occurrences.
Actual autōn is genitive-neuter-plural personal pronoun, rendered of-them with its true N source form; complete printed TR instead has singular reflexive heauto in the distribution phrase.

Actual echōn is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular having participle in both fields, rendered past finite English had. Complete printed TR has imperfect plural eichon; the actual N participial/masculine form is retained without an inferred past/plural tag.
Actual ana is the distribution preposition before six-wings, rendered respectively; no separate Greek respectively adverb is invented.

Actual gemousin is PRESENT ACTIVE third-plural fullness FINITE, expanded [are]-full. Unlike the verse6 participle, this written finite supplies the real predicate including English bracketed are, not an unprinted being lemma.
Actual echousin is present active third-plural having finite and owns they-have with its grammatically encoded subject; no independently printed they pronoun occurs.

Actual legontes is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL saying participle, while complete printed TR has neuter plural legonta. Both actual source fields and their masculine gender remain, without a silent agreement repair.
The three actual hagios occurrences are independent nominative-masculine-singular holy adjectives and own the three HOLY words separately.

Actual ho article is printed before Theos within the adjacent Kyrios-ho-Theos title, while English places its single corresponding the before LORD-God. This local title-order recast preserves the actual article and the separate Lord/God heads; it does not introduce a new source article before Kyrios.
Actual Pantokratōr is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular Almighty/ruler noun in both raw fields, not an adjective retag or a separately printed all/power pair.

Actual ho is nominative-masculine-singular article in the written ho-ēn designation and owns English who. The source anomalous article-plus-finite construction is retained rather than normalized or assigned an inferred participle.
Actual ēn is IMPERFECT ACTIVE third-singular being FINITE, rendered was with both source tags retained, distinct from the following actual present participle.
Actual ōn is PRESENT ACTIVE nominative-masculine-singular being PARTICIPLE, rendered finite English is while keeping its real form and separate source occurrence.
Actual erchomenos is PRESENT nonactive/deponent nominative-masculine-singular coming participle, expanded is-coming without a second Greek eimi finite or a future retag.

4:9.sourceText: Καὶ ὅταν δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων,
4:9.targetText: and when the living creatures give glory, and honor, and thanksgiving, to the [One] sitting on the throne, the [One] living through the ages of the ages,

groups.note: Actual hotan is one temporal/conditional conjunction rendered when, not separately written hote/an words.
Actual dōsousin is FUTURE ACTIVE third-plural giving finite, rendered present English give after when; its real future indicative remains rather than a subjunctive/present retag.

Actual dative-masculine-singular article nominalizes the following actual sitting participle and jointly conveys recipient case plus the-One personal designation in to-the-[One], without an independent source one numeral or to preposition.

Actual second dative-masculine-singular article nominalizes the written living participle and owns the-[One] personal designation, not an independently written numeral. The actual dative remains despite English not repeating a recipient to.
Actual zōnti is PRESENT ACTIVE dative-masculine-singular living participle, not an adjective or finite source form.
Actual genitive-plural article conveys of-the before its separately printed ages noun; case plus definiteness are both retained without assigning only a bare of to an article.

4:10.sourceText: πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, λέγοντες
4:10.targetText: the twenty-four elders will fall down before the [One] sitting on the throne, and worship the [One] living through the ages of the ages, and they will cast their garlands before the throne, saying,

groups.note: Actual pesountai has functional V-FNI-3P and formal V-FDI-3P future nonactive/deponent analyses, expanded will-fall-down with actual future and piptō head preserved; no independent down source word occurs.
Actual presbyteroi is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL comparative adjective used personally, rendered elders with both A-NPM-C analyses retained rather than retagged noun.
Actual genitive article nominalizes the real sitting participle and owns the-[One] personal frame; the governing before preposition has its separate actual source identity.

Actual proskynēsousin is FUTURE ACTIVE third-plural worshiping finite, rendered worship within the English coordinated will frame. Complete printed TR has present proskynousin; actual N future remains, not an English-inferred present tag.
Actual dative article nominalizes the living participle as the worship recipient and owns the-[One]; no independent Greek One numeral or different named referent is supplied.
Actual genitive article owns of-the before its separately written ages noun, preserving case plus definiteness.

Actual balousin is FUTURE ACTIVE third-plural casting finite, expanded they-will-cast with its grammatically encoded subject. Complete printed TR has present ballousin; the actual N future remains and no extra they pronoun is invented.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual garlands article is not separately expressed in the English possessive their-garlands phrase.

4:11.sourceText: Ἄξιος εἶ, ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν, ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας τὰ πάντα, καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.
4:11.targetText: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive the glory, and the honor, and the power, because You created all things, and because of Your will they existed and were created.”

groups.note: Actual ei is PRESENT ACTIVE second-singular being finite, expanded are-You with its grammatically encoded subject. The later independently printed sy owns the separate created-clause You.
Actual Kyrios is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE singular Lord noun in the address, while complete printed TR has vocative kyrie; the actual form is retained rather than a vocative retag.

Actual hēmōn is genitive first-plural possessor of the coordinated Lord-and-God title, rendered our with the actual later source position preserved. Complete printed TR omits this coordinated God/our title material; no source omission is inferred from the LSV presence.
Actual labein is second-aorist active receiving infinitive, rendered to-receive with its real form retained.
Actual neuter-plural article substantivizes the all adjective, expanded things without a separately printed thing noun; the independently written panta owns all.
Actual dia before accusative will owns because-of as the causal preposition, distinct from the earlier actual hoti because connector.

Actual ēsan is IMPERFECT ACTIVE third-plural being/existing finite, expanded they-existed with its encoded subject. Complete printed TR has present eisin; actual N imperfect remains rather than a present retag.
Actual ektisthēsan is AORIST PASSIVE third-plural creation finite, expanded were-created with actual passive preserved; it is distinct from the earlier active second-singular creation predicate.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual Lord article is not separately expressed alongside the English possessive our-Lord designation.
The actual God article is not separately expressed in the English coordinated possessive our-Lord-and-God phrase.
The actual will article is not separately expressed beside the English possessive Your-will.
